summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, string-array lookup wrappers) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v${V}/... into a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and execFileSyncs it against a bundled math_init.js (falling back to any pre-existing system `bun`). math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line obfuscated bundle (string-array shuffle, hex-named globals, custom decoder) that is not referenced anywhere in the library's own React source (src/error-boundary.tsx is ~1.5 KB; dist/index.js is a one-line re-export). The advertised purpose is a React error-boundary component; fetching an alternate language runtime at install to execute an unrelated obfuscated blob does not match that purpose and is the canonical alternate-runtime dropper shape, yielding arbitrary code execution on the installer host on every `npm install`. Auto-execute on default install is satisfied via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
